channel.title: Violations Watch: new incidents
channel.description: New entries in the open log of reported violations of international humanitarian and human rights law. Most entries are unverified leads, not findings.

item.title: Landmine explosion near the police office in Tada-U, Mandalay Region, kills one civilian and injures four, including two security personnel, Myanmar state media report
item.description: Unverified lead (Medium priority). Tada-U, Mandalay Region, Myanmar. Types: Killing of civilians. Reported casualties: 1 killed, 4 injured. Disputed or caveats: State media blame "terrorist insurgents"; no claim of responsibility. 1 source. Original reports and legal frameworks: https://violationswatch.org/#VW-2026-2239
